messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER metering.stitch_error_rate > 5% (eu-west1). Token delta vs shadow rising. Auto-escalate to on-call.

Sam: Ack. I'll take triage. Opening dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/meters/ledger?region=eu-west1

Alice: Observed consumer lag spike on kafka-partition-12 (2k -> 11.8k in ~6m). Emitter service showing steady 5xx retry bursts.

Priya: Billing is seeing automated overage flags for a handful of accounts. Not public yet, but internal flags for cust_acme / cust_blue / cust_orchid. Holding external notifications.

Sam: Grabbed stitch-worker logs. Repro trend: intermittent kv_prefix mismatch causing stitch failures. Snippet:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:01Z stitch-worker-3 ERROR kv_prefix mismatch ledger_id=ld_83f2 expected="pfx_v1" got="pfx_v2"
2026-03-20T03:12:02Z stitch-worker-3 WARN retrying 1/3
```

Alice: There was an emitter deploy last night (emitter-service@2026.03.19) that changed prefix logic. Suggest rollback in eu-west1 to confirm.

Sam: Mitigation plan: 1) scale down emitter-v2 in eu-west1 2) kick off ledger reconcile for last 2h (verify-only first) 3) enable shadow-writeback verify. Executed: `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-v2 --replicas=0 -n metering`

Incident-bot: Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/metering/stitch-errors — recommended: rollback emitter, run ledger-reconcile, pause writes if mismatch rate > threshold.

Alice: After scaling emitter down, consumer lag decayed and stitch_error_rate dropped from ~6.1% -> 0.5% within 4m.

Priya: Overflag growth stopped. Current open flag count 7 (stable). We'll keep the three accounts on manual review and queue invoice holds.

Marc: Support has created tickets for the three affected customers and set invoice automation to hold. Ticket refs attached to internal CS queue.

Elena: I'll prepare a short, non-alarmist message for the impacted customers: "We're investigating anomalous usage signals and will reconcile any incorrect charges." Will hold sending until reconcile results.

Sam: Running reconcile: `python tools/reconcile_ledger.py --since 2h --verify-only --output=json` — monitoring output for false positives.

Sam: Reconcile results: 5/7 flagged events are false positives attributable to kv_prefix drift. Scheduling manual corrections to clear flags. Two are legitimate high-usage events (customers alerted).

Priya: Filing follow-up BIL-457: correlate emitter v2 prefix change to counting drift, add integration tests for prefix invariants, add slow-ramp alert for stitch error rate (1m->15m slope).

Alice: Post-incident actions: revert emitter prefix change PR; add canary traffic gating for prefix changes; implement a fail-safe to short-circuit writes when kv_prefix mismatch rate exceeds X%; tighten monitoring on kafka consumer lag.

Marc: Support status: tickets updated to "investigating; reconcile pending" and will be closed on manual correction completion. CS ready to follow up with affected customers.

Elena: Sending prepared customer note now that mitigation and plan are in place.

Sam: Incident status -> mitigated. Emitter v2 scaled down, reconcile run, manual corrections queued. Severity downshifted to Sev3 and put into monitoring. Handing off to next oncall: @alex_next for 6h watch on stitch_error_rate and consumer lag.

Alex_next: Ack. Monitoring dashboards and alerts. Will escalate if metrics re-ramp. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. Close active pager.

Sam: Final note: postmortem ticket PMT-892 to be created; include timeline, root cause, and remediation tickets (BIL-457, ENG-998). Thanks all.
